_definition: Curated list of Europe-micro companies in current financial distress / insolvency proceedings (same definition as the Europe file). Informational only.

ENXTPA:BIG.summary: Accelerated safeguard (sauvegarde acceleree) proceeding opened by Lille Metropole commercial court judgment of 17 Aug 2026; extended on 7 Oct 2026 to ~9-17 Dec 2026 (sources differ); restructuring to complete by end Q1 2027. Shares were temporarily suspended 20 Feb 2026 and resumed 4 Mar 2026; still quoted in Aug 2026 (AbcBourse 14 Aug 2026). Current trading status after Aug 2026 not confirmed.

ATSE:MASTIHA.summary: Trading suspended: Euronext Athens suspended trading in Oct 2026 (company announcement 07/10/2026 on inventory discrepancies found in internal audit; external audit ~2 months; shares remain suspended until further notice). Earlier suspension 2026-05-04 to 2026-07-03 over republished FY2025 financial statements (auditor qualified opinion).

AIM:CRU.summary: Trading suspended: Shares on AIM temporarily suspended from 2 Nov 2026 (reported; RNS dated 30 Oct 2026) because audit of FY to 30 Apr 2026 delayed, missing AIM Rule 19 deadline of 31 Oct; company expects to publish audited accounts by 30 Nov 2026, trading to resume afterwards. No cancellation of admission found.

MUN:ABK.summary: Insolvency proceedings in self-administration (Eigenverwaltung) opened ~28 Aug 2026 (AG Aalen reported) for the operating subsidiary ABK Betriebsgesellschaft der Aktienbrauerei Kaufbeuren GmbH, application filed June 2026; 84 jobs cut to 38, brewing continues, investor search ongoing. The listed AG (Munich) holds a stake in the subsidiary; no delisting found; AGM was called for 22.07.2026 (result not seen). Whether AG itself is insolvent is unclear.
